main_text.head: LAPSVS MEMORIÆ, QVI LOMBARDO IN HOC PRIMO Sententiarum libro exciderunt.
main_text.l: Distinct.35.cap.6.Ambrosij locus ab isto citatus nusquam extat.
Distinct.37. cap. 1. Gregorij Magni locus nusquam extat.
Distinct.40.cap.4.Augustini dictum ex epistola ad Prosperum & Hilarium nusquam in ipsius operibus extat.
Distinct.41.cap.6. Augustini locus ex lib. De Spiritu & Litera nusquam.
Distinct.46.cap.7.Hieronymi dictum in Marcum nusquam legitur.
Cap.9.prius Augustini dictum notatum N, 1. nusquam extat.

p.i: Ridiculum est debilitati & fracti totius corporis vulnera pauca monstrare. Non eligo, quod reprehendam, eligat ipse quod vitio careat.

page.notes: The heading and the closing line are set in spaced capitals; the errata list lines are printed with some words set in italic (Distinct., Ambrosij, etc. are roman, the final quotation is italic). Line "Cap.9.prius" and "Distinctio.47" follow the printed text as shown. Some letters in the scan are faint, notably in "Gregorij" and "Hieronymi", but read as printed.
